audit.action: a better source should be cited for the same classification
audit.reasoning: Coding 'fixed-strict' initial primary stress with secondary on alternate (3rd, 5th) syllables, final secondary optional, rests on Olkkonen 1985:39 §5.1, the primary SIL phonology of the language; the quotation is verbatim in the copy consulted (scanned text and page scan both checked). The only other phonology in Glottolog's list, Gasaway 1997 (PL A-87) p.60, is held and independently states stress is predictable and always initial. No grammar, dissertation or instrumental study exists per Glottolog (3 descriptive refs total) and web search; the remaining unheld ref (Pilhofer 1928-29) is a German morphology survey and not a stress source. Nothing found contradicts the classification.
